record.title: Cameroon October 2018 presidential election border closure order
record.scope: National frontier closure order; land component retained
record.imposing_authority: Minister of Territorial Administration Paul Atanga Nji
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; current status not inferred
record.official_rationale: Secure presidential polling amid separatist threats to disrupt voting
record.context: The minister announced frontier closure at a 5 October 2018 press conference, reported as 48 hours before the 7 October vote. A Ministry of Communication account explicitly describing 7 October says borders had been closed since the previous day, implying 6 October. Domestic travel restrictions are not treated as the international border schedule.
record.uncertainty: The reported schedule implies 5 October, but the government election-day account implies 6 October. Exact effective and operational onset remains unresolved and is encoded only to month. 8 October is scheduled reopening, not verified actual reopening.

historical.duration_note: Scheduled or ordered reopening; actual operational duration not established
